title: Changes inside Barber's program after the 2017 New York Times article

tellings.quote: When the New York Times article came out like 2017, uh it was really about then things started getting really weird for us

plain: Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot who says he flew in a secret programme that recovered crashed UFOs, says life inside that programme changed once The New York Times published "Glowing Auras and 'Black Money': The Pentagon's Mysterious U.F.O. Program" on 16 December 2017, an article that revealed a secret Pentagon UFO study. Barber tells Michels from his own experience that "it was really about then things started getting really weird for us".
